learning_objective: ✨ Practice special focus exercises to build a super strong mind, find inner peace, and learn how to relax completely!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Sit safely on the floor with your legs crossed in a comfortable shape. Keep your back straight, rest your hands on your knees, and close your eyes gently.
Yoga Sadhana trains your brain! Pick one thing to look at, like a flower or a spot on the wall. Stare at it without blinking or moving to build your laser focus.
Take a deep breath in, and as you breathe out, slowly say the word O-M-M-M. Feel the happy vibrations buzzing in your chest and throat like a little bee!

fun_activity.title: 🤫 The One-Minute Statue
fun_activity.instructions: Set a timer for 60 seconds. Sit in Sukhasana, close your eyes, and pretend you are a beautiful stone statue. Can you stay completely still until the timer rings?

quick_recap: ⭐ Sitting in Sukhasana with a straight back keeps your spine healthy and strong.
⭐ Practicing focus helps you pay better attention in class and during homework.
⭐ Chanting Om creates happy energy inside your body and makes you feel peaceful.
